people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
translations.bsb: Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland, and Balak also went on his way.
translations.kjv: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
translations.asv: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
